description: Give claim-deadline guidance for a flight under EU261 or UK261: a recommended act-by date (flight date + 12 months), the legal time-limit guidance, and an evidence checklist. Use for 'how long do I have to claim?'. Do NOT use to check eligibility; use check_compensation.

flight_date.description: Date of the disrupted flight, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-09-01

scheme.description: EU261 (EU/EEA departure or EU carrier) or UK261 (UK departure or UK carrier); check_compensation tells you which.

name: claim_timeline

disclaimer.description: Not-legal-advice disclaimer to show the user.

evidence_checklist.description: Evidence to gather, one per entry.

window_guidance.description: Legal time-limit guidance for the scheme.

title: Claim timeline
